A '''conspiracy''' among six members of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]] was formed in order to overthrow the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and prevent him from waging war on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] had discovered the Emperor's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nathema]] and understood that he was a threat to all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, the conspiracy was largely ineffectual, and its members&mdash;including [[Darth Nyriss]]&mdash;were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Purge of the Dark Council|purge]] of the Dark Council in [[3950 BBY]].<ref name="Revan" />
